title: Fanki's Modpack
description: over 40 carefully selected mods that will completely enhance your gameplay
body: This modpack offers a fresh and immersive Minecraft experience with over **40 carefully selected mods** that enhance gameplay, performance, and visuals. Enjoy Iris for stunning shaders, Ambient Sounds for a more atmospheric world, smooth animations, and many other improvements that bring your adventures to life. Whether you love exploring, building, or simply relaxing, this pack makes every session more engaging, immersive, and enjoyable!
